Subject: Your cheque bounce matter

Dear Mr. Varghese,

Thank you for meeting us on 29 November 2022 about your dispute with Chandran Enterprises. As we understand it, the drawer stopped the cheque with a stop-payment instruction. The matter is listed before the Judicial Magistrate First Class Court at Kochi.

Our advice is to argue that a stop-payment instruction does not protect the drawer when the debt is admitted. Please collect the written acknowledgement of the debt and the stop-payment memo and send copies to this office. We will pursue the full claim of Rs 24,80,000.

Regards,
Adv. Mrinalini Saraf
